about:
Battlefield Fabrication operates from Searcy, Arkansas, where it runs a family-owned construction and building-supply business. The company does not disclose its founding year or the names of its founders, but it describes itself as a small, family-owned operation that has grown into a licensed and insured contractor serving White County and the surrounding Central Arkansas region.

The company provides a full range of site-to-finish services: site preparation and dirt work (clearing, grading), concrete foundations (slabs and footings), and custom construction of barndominiums, pole barns, stud-wall shops, and portable buildings. It also installs standing-seam and exposed-fastener metal roofing, supplies building kits (shop kits and portable-building kits), and offers LVP flooring and countertop installation. The firm operates from a location at 2910 Highway 16 in Searcy, but it does not publish facility size, headcount, or annual volume figures.

Battlefield Fabrication serves property owners and developers in White County and nearby areas who need agricultural structures such as pole barns, residential barndominiums, commercial shop buildings, and portable storage or office units. The company markets itself as a turnkey builder for both standalone metal-roofing projects and complete new builds.

The company emphasizes its family-owned status, licensed and insured standing, and a focus on seamless communication from project start to finish as key differentiators. It also highlights affordable pricing and the convenience of a single contractor handling everything from dirt work to final roofing.
